newsitem.title: USA: Introgen receives $5 mln milestone payment.
newsitem.headline: Introgen receives $5 mln milestone payment.

text.p: Introgen Therapeutics Inc said Friday Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc has made a $5 million milestone payment to the company.

The payment, said Introgen, was for continued progress in Introgen's p53 in vivo gene therapy program, a potential cancer treatment. Introgen is conducting Phase I/II clinical trials with Rhone-Poulenc's gene therapy division.
By the end of 1997, Introgen said it expects to have received at least $44 million out of a potential $50 million possible under its agreement with Rhone-Poulenc.

Introgen was formed to commercialize anti- cancer technology developed at the University of Texas M.D. Anderson Cancer Center in Houston. Its primary focus is the development of in vivo gene-based cancer therapies.
